claim: The first nine months of fiscal 2026 gross profit figure for Nike was $14.5B.
summary: As of knowledge cutoff 2026-01-04, Nike's first nine months of fiscal 2026 (June 1, 2025 - Feb 28, 2026) had not been completed/reported — Q3 FY2026 ends Feb 2026 and is typically reported in March 2026 — so the nine-month gross profit figure cannot be verified without tools; no evidence available to confirm $14.5B.

sub_claims.text: Nike's gross profit for the first nine months of fiscal 2026 was $14.5 billion
sub_claims.note: No tool access and knowledge cutoff 2026-01-04 is before the end of Nike's FY2026 Q3 (Feb 28, 2026) and its earnings release; the nine-month FY2026 gross profit total cannot be established from prior knowledge alone.
